notes: Passive, transformer-based (Whirlwind TRHL) direct box — no power input/connector exists (no battery, no phantom power required). A GND/LIFT toggle switch (not a connector) disconnects ground between input and XLR output. The two 1/4" jacks are wired in parallel/interchangeable; labeled here as IN and THRU per the manufacturer's manual, matching how retailers (Sweetwater, B&H) list them as "1 x 1/4\" input" and "1 x 1/4\" thru." No grade set on any port — all are analog audio connectors, outside the graded connector families (SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/RJ45). Desktop stagebox unit (2-5/8" x 4-3/8" x 1-3/8" steel enclosure), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Confirmed against manufacturer product page (whirlwindusa.com), manufacturer spec-sheet PDF, and manufacturer instruction manual PDF (hosted on Whirlwind's own CDN), which explicitly names all three physical ports. Cross-checked against Sweetwater/B&H spec tables — consistent (1x 1/4" in, 1x XLR out, 1x 1/4" thru).

ports.name: HIGH Z IN
ports.note: Parallel-wired with the THRU jack (1/4" TS, unbalanced, high-Z instrument/line level); either 1/4" jack can serve as input or thru-output.

ports.name: HIGH Z THRU
ports.note: Parallel loop-through of the input signal (1/4" TS, unbalanced).

ports.name: LOW Z OUT
ports.note: Male XLR, 150 ohm balanced mic-level output via Whirlwind TRHL transformer.
